# Table 1: participant characteristics by round (NHATS Rounds 11-14)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(refund); library(nlme); library(RLRsim); library(broom); library(haven)
```


\textbf{Comment:} Raw NHATS data from Rounds 11–14 were processed to create the final cleaned dataset used in the analysis. Details of the data processing and analytical procedures are provided in Sanim et al.

```{r, exploratory table}
BASE <- "/Users/arifsanim/Function_data_Research"
load(file.path(BASE, "Reviwer_comment/merged_clean_r11-14.RData"))   # merged_clean
stopifnot(nrow(merged_clean) == 2416)

base_dirs <- setNames(file.path(BASE, c("NHATS_R11_Beta_Release_SAS",
                                        "NHATS_R12_Final_Release_SAS_V2",
                                        "NHATS_R13_Final_Release_SAS",
                                        "NHATS_R14_Beta_Release_SAS")), 11:14)

AGE_LEVELS <- c("70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85-89", "90+")

# ---- Wear metrics (NHATS Accel_Summ_File) ---------------------------------

wear <- map_dfr(11:14, function(r) {
  list.files(base_dirs[[as.character(r)]], "Accel_Summ_File\\.sas7bdat$",
             full.names = TRUE)[1] %>%
    read_sas() %>%
    transmute(spid, round = r,
              valid_days = .data[[paste0("ag", r, "dnumdaysval")]],
              wear_min   = .data[[paste0("ag", r, "dnummin")]],
              active_min = .data[[paste0("ag", r, "dminact")]])
}) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(spid, round), ~ if_else(.x < 0, NA, .x)))

# ---- Analysis data --------------------------------------------------------

base_age <- merged_clean %>%
  filter(round == 11) %>%
  distinct(spid, base_age = age_group)

d <- merged_clean %>%
  transmute(spid, round = as.integer(round), sex, bmi, age_group) %>%
  left_join(base_age, by = "spid") %>%
  left_join(wear, by = c("spid", "round")) %>%
  mutate(sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
         base_age  = factor(base_age,  levels = AGE_LEVELS),
         age_group = factor(age_group, levels = AGE_LEVELS))

# ---- Summaries: n (%) and mean (SD) by round ------------------------------

n_pct <- function(var, label) {
  d %>%
    count(round, level = {{ var }}, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(round) %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / sum(n))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(Variable = paste0(label, level), round, cell)
}

mean_sd <- function(var, label, digits = 1) {
  fmt <- sprintf("%%.%1$df (%%.%1$df)", digits)
  d %>%
    group_by(round) %>%
    summarise(cell = sprintf(fmt, mean({{ var }}, na.rm = TRUE),
                             sd({{ var }}, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Variable = label)
}

sections <- list(
  "Demographics"        = bind_rows(n_pct(sex, "Sex: "),
                                    mean_sd(bmi, "BMI, kg/m²")),
  "Baseline age group"  = n_pct(base_age,  "Age group: "),
  "Age group at round"  = n_pct(age_group, "Age group: "),
  "Accelerometry wear"  = bind_rows(mean_sd(valid_days, "Valid wear days"),
                                    mean_sd(wear_min,   "Wear minutes per day", 0),
                                    mean_sd(active_min, "Active minutes per day"))
)

table1 <- map(sections, ~ pivot_wider(.x, names_from = round, values_from = cell)) %>%
  bind_rows()


# printing table
N <- count(d, round)$n
col_names <- c("", sprintf("Round %d (N = %d)", 11:14, N))

kbl(table1, col.names = col_names, align = "lcccc", booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Descriptive summaries of the variables included in the analysis, by study round (NHATS Rounds 11–14)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
  pack_rows(index = map_int(sections, ~ n_distinct(.x$Variable))) %>%
  footnote(general = paste(
    "Cells are n (%) for categorical variables and mean (SD) for continuous variables;",
    "continuous summaries are computed over non-missing values. Active minutes are",
    "NHATS-derived (minutes/day above 1853 cpm over 24 h) and are not directly",
    "comparable with the intensity categories in Supplementary Table 1."),
    general_title = "", threeparttable = TRUE)
```



```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

source(file.path(BASE, "Profit_Sim/Profit_V1.R"))
source(file.path(BASE, "Main_folder/Profit_weighted.R"))

# data cleaning part

func_cols <- str_subset(names(merged_clean), "^dmeanmin")

merged_clean <- merged_clean %>%
  mutate(round = as.integer(round),
         across(all_of(func_cols), ~ na_if(.x, -9))) %>%
  arrange(spid, round)

stopifnot(nrow(merged_clean) == 2416)
print(count(merged_clean, round))                    # 747 / 639 / 550 / 480

Y <- as.matrix(merged_clean[, func_cols])
cat("min activity value:", min(Y, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")   # must not be -9

# results from profit (table 2 and table 3)

ids <- unique(merged_clean$spid)
m   <- as.integer(table(factor(merged_clean$spid, levels = ids)))
vtl <- split(merged_clean$round, factor(merged_clean$spid, levels = ids))
tt  <- sort(unique(merged_clean$round))

# Y rows must be blocked by subject in the order m describes
stopifnot(identical(as.character(merged_clean$spid), as.character(rep(ids, m))))

set.seed(1234)
profit_result <- profit_data_driven(
  Y = Y, s = seq_along(func_cols), tt = tt, m = m,
  visit.time = unlist(vtl, use.names = FALSE),
  ind.tgrid  = lapply(vtl, function(x) match(x, tt)),
  pve = 0.9, num_knots = 3)

K   <- profit_result$K
THR <- 0.05 / K
cat("K =", K, "  Bonferroni threshold =", signif(THR, 4), "\n")

table_2 <- tibble(PC     = paste0("PC", 1:K),
                  nlme   = as.numeric(profit_result$pValue[1, ]),
                  direct = as.numeric(profit_result$pValue[2, ]))
knitr::kable(
  table_2,
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c("Component", "NLME/RLRsim p-value", "Direct optimization p-value"),
  caption = "Component-specific PROFIT p-values",
  booktabs = TRUE
)

table_3 <- tibble(method  = c("NLME/RLRsim", "Direct optimization"),
                  max_stat = profit_result$max_TestStat,
                  min_p    = profit_result$min_pValue,
                  K = K, threshold = THR,
                  reject = profit_result$min_pValue < THR)
knitr::kable(
  table_3,
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c("Method", "Maximum test statistic", "Minimum p-value",
                "K", "Bonferroni threshold", "Reject"),
  caption = "Overall PROFIT test results",
  booktabs = TRUE
)

```

```{r remaining-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Shared definitions
stopifnot(nrow(Y) == nrow(merged_clean), ncol(Y) == length(func_cols))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(merged_clean[c("spid", "round")]))
stopifnot(identical(as.character(merged_clean$spid), as.character(rep(ids, m))))

grid_idx <- parse_number(func_cols)
WAKE    <- c(301, 1380)
MORNING <- c(301, 660)
MIDDAY  <- c(661, 1020)
EVENING <- c(1021, 1380)
SED_CUT  <- 2860
MVPA_CUT <- 3941
in_win <- function(w) grid_idx >= w[1] & grid_idx <= w[2]

covars <- merged_clean %>%
  select(spid, round, sex, bmi) %>%
  left_join(merged_clean %>% filter(round == 11) %>%
              distinct(spid, base_age = age_group), by = "spid") %>%
  mutate(base_age = factor(as.character(base_age), AGE_LEVELS),
         sex      = factor(sex, c("Female", "Male")))

fit <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    left_join(covars, by = c("spid", "round")) %>%
    mutate(round = relevel(factor(round), "11")) %>%
    lme(y ~ round + base_age + sex + bmi, random = ~ 1 | spid,
        data = ., na.action = na.omit, method = "REML")
}

tidy_lme <- function(m) {
  summary(m)$tTable %>% as_tibble(rownames = "term") %>%
    transmute(term,
              estimate = round(Value, 3), se = round(Std.Error, 3), df = DF,
              t = round(`t-value`, 3),
              p = if_else(`p-value` < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", `p-value`)))
}

win_mean <- function(w) {
  merged_clean %>%
    transmute(spid, round, y = rowMeans(Y[, in_win(w), drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    fit()
}
```

## Table 4: Overall mean physical activity

```{r table-4, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
m_4 <- win_mean(c(min(grid_idx), max(grid_idx)))  # Full available daily grid
table_4 <- tidy_lme(m_4)

knitr::kable(
  table_4, digits = 3, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Term", "Estimate", "SE", "DF", "t-value", "p-value"),

)
```

## Table 5: FPC1 and FPC2 score models

```{r table-5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
stopifnot(ncol(profit_result$phi) >= 4)
if (anyNA(Y)) {
  stop("The supplied FPC projection requires complete Y; resolve missing activity values before scoring.")
}
phi <- profit_result$phi[, 1:4]
fpc <- scale(Y %*% phi / length(func_cols))
fpc[, 1] <- fpc[, 1] * sign(mean(phi[, 1]))
fpc[, 2] <- fpc[, 2] * sign(mean(phi[in_win(MORNING), 2]) -
                              mean(phi[in_win(EVENING), 2]))
colnames(fpc) <- paste0("FPC", 1:4)

stopifnot(cor(fpc[, 1], rowMeans(Y, na.rm = TRUE)) > 0.9)

m_5 <- list(
  FPC1 = merged_clean %>% transmute(spid, round, y = fpc[, 1]) %>% fit(),
  FPC2 = merged_clean %>% transmute(spid, round, y = fpc[, 2]) %>% fit())

table_5 <- imap_dfr(m_5, ~ tidy_lme(.x) %>% mutate(outcome = .y, .before = 1))
table_5_display <- table_5 %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = c(estimate, se, df, t, p),
              names_glue = "{outcome}_{.value}") %>%
  select(term, starts_with("FPC1_"), starts_with("FPC2_"))

knitr::kable(
  table_5_display,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  align = c("l", rep("r", 10)),
  col.names = c("Term", rep(c("Estimate", "SE", "DF", "t", "p-value"), 2)),
  caption = "Mixed-effects models for normalized FPC1 and FPC2 scores"
) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "FPC1" = 5, "FPC2" = 5)) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    font_size = 8,
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")
  )
```

## Supplementary Table 1: Activity intensity composition by round

```{r supplementary-table-1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Waking-window intensity percentages
Yw <- Y[, in_win(WAKE), drop = FALSE]
nw <- rowSums(!is.na(Yw))

tiers <- merged_clean %>%
  transmute(spid, round,
            SED  = 100 * rowSums(Yw <  SED_CUT, na.rm = TRUE) / nw,
            LPA  = 100 * rowSums(Yw >= SED_CUT & Yw < MVPA_CUT, na.rm = TRUE) / nw,
            MVPA = 100 * rowSums(Yw >= MVPA_CUT, na.rm = TRUE) / nw)

table_S1 <- tiers %>%
  pivot_longer(c(SED, LPA, MVPA)) %>%
  group_by(round, name) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), m = mean(value), s = sd(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f) [%.2f]", m, s, s / sqrt(N))) %>%
  select(round, N, name, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = cell) %>%
  select(round, N, SED, LPA, MVPA)
knitr::kable(
  table_S1, digits = 3, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Round", "N", "SED mean (SD) [SE]", "LPA mean (SD) [SE]", "MVPA mean (SD) [SE]"),
  caption = "Supplementary Table 1. Distribution of waking-window activity intensity by round"
)
```

## Supplementary Table 2: FPC correlations with accelerometry metrics

```{r supplementary-table-2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# dminact = minutes/day ABOVE 1853 cpm; dminnon = minutes/day BELOW it
# (User Guide Appendix A). dminnon is the complement of dminact, NOT non-wear.

PEAK_VAR <- "dmax10"     # try dmax30 / dmax60

summ <- map_dfr(11:14, function(r) {
  f <- list.files(base_dirs[[as.character(r)]], "Accel_Summ_File\\.sas7bdat$",
                  full.names = TRUE)[1]
  read_sas(f) %>%
    transmute(spid, round = r,
              tac       = .data[[sprintf("ag%ddtac",        r)]],
              act_min   = .data[[sprintf("ag%ddminact",     r)]],
              nonact    = .data[[sprintf("ag%ddminnon",     r)]],
              peak      = .data[[sprintf("ag%d%s",          r, PEAK_VAR)]],
              wear_min  = .data[[sprintf("ag%ddnummin",     r)]],
              valid_day = .data[[sprintf("ag%ddnumdaysval", r)]]) %>%
    mutate(across(-c(spid, round), ~ na_if(.x, -9)))
})

q <- quantile(Y, c(0.25, 0.90), na.rm = TRUE)   # pooled reference

metrics <- merged_clean %>%
  transmute(spid, round,
            mean_act  = rowMeans(Y, na.rm = TRUE),
            morning   = rowMeans(Y[, grid_idx >=  361 & grid_idx <=  720], na.rm = TRUE),
            evening   = rowMeans(Y[, grid_idx >= 1021 & grid_idx <= 1260], na.rm = TRUE),
            overnight = rowMeans(Y[, grid_idx >=    1 & grid_idx <=  360], na.rm = TRUE),
            hi_min    = rowSums(Y >  q[2], na.rm = TRUE),
            lo_min    = rowSums(Y <= q[1], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(summ, by = c("spid", "round"))

stopifnot(cor(metrics$act_min, metrics$nonact, use = "complete.obs") < -0.95)

labels <- c(mean_act  = "Mean activity",
            tac       = "Total activity counts (dtac)",
            act_min   = "Active minutes >1853 cpm (dminact)",
            peak      = paste0("Peak activity (", PEAK_VAR, ")"),
            hi_min    = "Minutes > 90th pct of counts",
            lo_min    = "Minutes <= 25th pct of counts",
            morning   = "Morning activity (06-12h)",
            evening   = "Evening activity (17-21h)",
            overnight = "Overnight activity (00-06h)",
            wear_min  = "Wear minutes on valid days (dnummin)",
            valid_day = "Valid wear days (dnumdaysval)")

table_S2 <- metrics %>%
  select(all_of(names(labels))) %>%
  imap_dfr(function(x, nm) {
    correlations <- cor(x, fpc, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")[1, ]
    bind_cols(tibble(metric = labels[[nm]]),
              as_tibble_row(setNames(round(correlations, 2), colnames(fpc))))
  })

knitr::kable(
  table_S2, digits = 2, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Supplementary Table 2. FPC correlations with accelerometry metrics"
)
```

## Supplementary Table 5: IPCW diagnostics and sensitivity analysis

```{r supplementary-table-5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cohort <- merged_clean %>% filter(round == 11) %>% pull(spid) %>% unique()

obs <- expand_grid(spid = cohort, round = 11:14) %>%
  left_join(merged_clean %>% distinct(spid, round) %>% mutate(R = TRUE),
            by = c("spid", "round")) %>%
  mutate(R = coalesce(R, FALSE))

# The original cumulative weights require monotone attrition.
if (!all(merged_clean$spid %in% cohort)) {
  stop("IPCW section assumes all participants were observed at Round 11.")
}
returned_after_gap <- obs %>%
  arrange(spid, round) %>%
  group_by(spid) %>%
  mutate(returned = R & lag(cumany(!R), default = FALSE)) %>%
  ungroup()
if (any(returned_after_gap$returned)) {
  stop("The supplied IPCW code assumes monotone attrition; returning participants require a revised observation model.")
}

dem_cov <- intersect(c("age", "sex", "bmi"), names(merged_clean))
fp      <- fpca.face(Y, pve = 0.9)
fpc_cov <- paste0("fpc", 1:3)

cov_all <- merged_clean %>%
  select(spid, round, all_of(dem_cov)) %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(fp$scores[, 1:3], .name_repair = ~ fpc_cov)) %>%
  mutate(activity = rowMeans(Y, na.rm = TRUE))

use_cov  <- c(dem_cov, fpc_cov)
cov_prev <- paste0(use_cov, "_prev")

fill_one <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) x[is.na(x)] <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  else x[is.na(x)] <- names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  x
}

lagged <- obs %>%
  left_join(cov_all, by = c("spid", "round")) %>%
  group_by(spid) %>% arrange(round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(R_prev = lag(R),
         across(all_of(c(use_cov, "activity")), lag, .names = "{.col}_prev")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(round >= 12, R_prev) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cov_prev), ~ as.integer(is.na(.x)), .names = "{.col}_miss"),
         across(all_of(cov_prev), fill_one),
         activity_prev_z = as.numeric(scale(activity_prev)))

miss_terms <- keep(paste0(cov_prev, "_miss"), ~ n_distinct(lagged[[.x]]) > 1)

or_activity <- glm(reformulate(c(paste0(dem_cov, "_prev"), "activity_prev_z",
                                 "factor(round)"), response = "R"),
                   data = lagged, family = binomial) %>%
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>% filter(term == "activity_prev_z")

pred_p <- map_dfr(12:14, function(j) {
  dd <- filter(lagged, round == j)
  mm <- glm(reformulate(c(cov_prev, miss_terms), response = "R"),
            data = dd, family = binomial)
  tibble(spid = dd$spid, round = j, R = dd$R,
         p_hat = as.numeric(predict(mm, type = "response")), p_marg = mean(dd$R))
})

wt <- pred_p %>%
  arrange(spid, round) %>% group_by(spid) %>%
  mutate(w_stab = cumprod(p_marg) / cumprod(p_hat)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(R) %>% select(spid, round, p_hat, w_stab) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(spid = cohort, round = 11L, p_hat = 1, w_stab = 1)) %>%
  group_by(round) %>% mutate(w = pmin(w_stab, quantile(w_stab, 0.99))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% arrange(spid, round)

stopifnot(nrow(wt) == nrow(merged_clean))

table_S5a <- wt %>% group_by(round) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            min_p_hat    = round(min(p_hat), 3),
            mean_w       = round(mean(w_stab), 3),
            max_w_untrim = round(max(w_stab), 2),
            n_trimmed    = sum(w_stab > w + 1e-12),
            ESS_trim     = round(sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2)),
            ESS_pct      = round(100 * (sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2)) / n(), 1),
            .groups = "drop")


dw <- merged_clean %>% left_join(select(wt, spid, round, w),
                                 by = c("spid", "round")) %>% arrange(spid, round)
stopifnot(!anyNA(dw$w), identical(as.character(dw$spid), as.character(rep(ids, m))))

profit_args <- list(Y = Y, s = seq_along(func_cols), tt = tt, m = m,
             visit.time = unlist(vtl, use.names = FALSE),
             ind.tgrid  = lapply(vtl, function(x) match(x, tt)),
             pve = 0.9, num_knots = 3)

set.seed(1234)
fit_unw  <- do.call(profit_data_driven_wtd, c(profit_args, list(wts = NULL)))
set.seed(1234)
fit_ipcw <- do.call(profit_data_driven_wtd, c(profit_args, list(wts = dw$w)))

sig_pcs <- function(f, row) {
  p <- as.numeric(f$pValue[row, ])
  paste0("PC", which(p < 0.05 / f$K), collapse = ", ")
}

table_S5b <- tibble(
  analysis   = c("Unweighted (primary)", "IPCW-weighted (sensitivity)"),
  K          = c(fit_unw$K, fit_ipcw$K),
  threshold  = round(0.05 / c(fit_unw$K, fit_ipcw$K), 5),
  sig_nlme   = c(sig_pcs(fit_unw, 1), sig_pcs(fit_ipcw, 1)),
  sig_direct = c(sig_pcs(fit_unw, 2), sig_pcs(fit_ipcw, 2)),
  conclusion = map_chr(list(fit_unw, fit_ipcw), function(f) {
    if (all(apply(f$pValue, 1, min) < 0.05 / f$K)) "Reject (both methods)"
    else if (all(apply(f$pValue, 1, min) >= 0.05 / f$K)) "Do not reject (both methods)"
    else "Methods differ"
  }))


# fit_unw is the same specification as profit_result -- K must agree
stopifnot(fit_unw$K == profit_result$K)

knitr::kable(
  table_S5a, digits = 3, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Supplementary Table 5a. IPCW diagnostics"
)

knitr::kable(
  table_S5b, digits = 3, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Supplementary Table 5b. PROFIT results with and without IPCW"
)

# Retention association reported in the Supplementary Table 5 note
knitr::kable(
  or_activity %>% select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value), digits = 3, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Term", "Odds ratio", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper", "p-value"),
  caption = "Supplementary Table 5 note. Prior activity and subsequent retention"
)
```

## Supplementary Table 7: Complete-case PROFIT sensitivity analysis

```{r supplementary-table-7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
run_profit <- function(data, num_knots = 3, label = "") {
  data <- arrange(data, spid, round)
  ids  <- unique(data$spid)
  m    <- as.integer(table(factor(data$spid, levels = ids)))
  vtl  <- split(data$round, factor(data$spid, levels = ids))
  tt   <- sort(unique(data$round))
  
  # Y rows must be blocked by subject in the order m describes
  stopifnot(identical(as.character(data$spid), as.character(rep(ids, m))))
  
  set.seed(1234)
  fit <- profit_data_driven(
    Y          = as.matrix(data[, func_cols]),
    s          = seq_along(func_cols),
    tt         = tt,
    m          = m,
    visit.time = unlist(vtl, use.names = FALSE),
    ind.tgrid  = lapply(vtl, function(x) match(x, tt)),
    pve        = 0.9,
    num_knots  = num_knots)
  
  fit
}

complete_ids <- merged_clean %>%
  count(spid) %>% filter(n == 4) %>% pull(spid)
fit_complete <- run_profit(filter(merged_clean, spid %in% complete_ids), 3,
                           "Complete case")

# Asterisks identify significance using each fit's own threshold.
format_pc_p <- function(f, row) {
  p <- as.numeric(f$pValue[row, ])
  paste0(ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.4f", p)),
         ifelse(p < 0.05 / f$K, "*", ""))
}

table_S7 <- tibble(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_len(fit_complete$K)),
  nlme = format_pc_p(fit_complete, 1),
  direct = format_pc_p(fit_complete, 2)
)

knitr::kable(
  table_S7, digits = 3, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Component", "NLME/RLRsim", "Direct optimization"),
  caption = "Supplementary Table 7. Complete-case PROFIT results"
)

# Actual threshold for the table note
threshold_S7 <- 0.05 / fit_complete$K
```

## Supplementary Table 9: Interview month and season by round

```{r supplementary-table-9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
get_month <- function(r, pat, var) {
  f <- list.files(base_dirs[[as.character(r)]],
                  paste0(pat, ".*\\.sas7bdat$"), full.names = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(f)) return(NULL)
  x <- read_sas(f); v <- sprintf(var, r)
  if (!v %in% names(x)) return(NULL)
  tibble(spid = x$spid, round = r, month = as.integer(x[[v]]))
}

months <- map_dfr(11:14, ~ bind_rows(get_month(.x, "SP_File",      "ab%sdatemonth"),
                                     get_month(.x, "Tracker_File", "r%sspstatdtm"))) %>%
  filter(month %in% 1:12) %>%
  distinct(spid, round, .keep_all = TRUE)

d_season <- merged_clean %>%
  transmute(spid, round, mean_pa = rowMeans(Y, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(months, by = c("spid", "round")) %>%
  mutate(season = case_when(month %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring", month %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
                            month %in% 9:11 ~ "Fall",  month %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "Winter"),
         season = factor(season, c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter")),
         month  = factor(month.name[month], month.name))

stopifnot(nrow(d_season) == nrow(merged_clean))
n_missing_month <- sum(is.na(d_season$month))

pct_by_round <- function(v) {
  d_season %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    count(round, level = .data[[v]], .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(round) %>% mutate(p = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    select(-n) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = round, values_from = p, names_prefix = "R")
}

table_S9 <- bind_rows(pct_by_round("season"), pct_by_round("month"))
knitr::kable(
  table_S9, digits = 1, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Supplementary Table 9. Interview season and month percentages by round"
)
```

```{r supplementary-table-10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
round_rows <- function(m, lab) {
  tidy_lme(m) %>% filter(str_starts(term, "round")) %>%
    transmute(term, !!lab := sprintf("%s (%s)", estimate, p))
```

## Figure 1: Mean activity curves across rounds

```{r figure-1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
figure_1 <- local({
  merged_clean <- figure_dat

  # Round labels
  round_labels <- c(
    `11` = "Round 11 (2021)",
    `12` = "Round 12 (2022)",
    `13` = "Round 13 (2023)",
    `14` = "Round 14 (2024)"
  )

  # Common theme function
  pub_theme <- function() {
    theme_bw() +
      theme(
        text = element_text(size = 12, family = "serif"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  }

  # PLOT 1: All Available Data
  long_data_all <- merged_clean %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("dmeanmin"), 
                 names_to = "variable", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(index = parse_number(variable))

  combined_all <- long_data_all %>%
    group_by(round, index) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  plot1 <- ggplot(combined_all, aes(x = index, y = mean_value, color = factor(round))) +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Study Round", labels = round_labels) +
    labs(x = "Time of Day (Minutes)", 
         y = "Mean Daily Activity",
         title = "All Available Data") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x, 1)) +
    pub_theme()

  # PLOT 2: Complete-case (Round 14 subjects)
  spids_r14 <- merged_clean %>%
    filter(round == 14) %>%
    pull(spid) %>%
    unique()

  long_data_r14 <- merged_clean %>%
    filter(spid %in% spids_r14) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("dmeanmin"), 
                 names_to = "variable", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(index = parse_number(variable))

  combined_r14 <- long_data_r14 %>%
    group_by(round, index) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  plot2 <- ggplot(combined_r14, aes(x = index, y = mean_value, color = factor(round))) +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Study Round", labels = round_labels) +
    labs(x = "Time of Day (Minutes)", 
         y = "Mean Daily Activity",
         title = "Complete-case (Round 14 subjects)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x, 1)) +
    pub_theme()

  # Extract legend from plot1
  get_legend <- function(plot) {
    tmp <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(plot + theme(legend.position = "bottom")))
    leg <- which(vapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) {
      grepl("^guide-box", x$name) && !inherits(x, "zeroGrob")
    }, logical(1)))
    if (!length(leg)) stop("No legend was found for Figure 1.")
    tmp$grobs[[leg[1]]]
  }

  legend <- get_legend(plot1)

  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    arrangeGrob(plot1, plot2, ncol = 2),
    legend,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(10, 1),
    top = textGrob("Comparison: All Data vs Complete-case (Round 14 subjects)",
                   gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "serif"))
  )

  combined
})

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(figure_1)

```

## Figure 2: Activity profiles by sex

```{r figure-2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7.3, fig.height=9}
figure_2 <- local({
  merged_clean <- figure_dat

  MISSING    <- -9
  SMOOTH_WIN <- 31        # centred rolling mean, in grid points
  CONF       <- 1.96

  SEX_LEVELS <- c("Female", "Male")
  SEX_COL <- c("Female" = "#1F4E79", "Male" = "#D98324")
  SEX_LTY <- c("Female" = "solid",   "Male" = "42")

  # grid

  func_cols   <- grep("^dmeanmin", names(merged_clean), value = TRUE)
  minute_cols <- func_cols[order(as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", func_cols)))]
  n_grid <- length(minute_cols)
  mpp    <- 1440 / n_grid

  roll <- function(x, k = SMOOTH_WIN) {
    if (k <= 1) return(x)
    as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1 / k, k), sides = 2, circular = TRUE))
  }

  analysis_dat <- merged_clean %>%
    mutate(sex = factor(as.character(sex), levels = SEX_LEVELS))

  if (anyNA(analysis_dat$sex)) {
    stop("sex labels do not match SEX_LEVELS; observed: ",
         paste(unique(as.character(merged_clean$sex)), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Curves

  compute_curves <- function(data) {
    
    long <- data %>%
      select(spid, round, grp = sex, all_of(minute_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(minute_cols), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(value = na_if(value, MISSING),
             hour  = (match(variable, minute_cols) - 0.5) * mpp / 60)
    
    curves <- long %>%
      group_by(round, grp, hour) %>%
      summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                se   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(round, grp, hour) %>%
      group_by(round, grp) %>%
      mutate(mean  = roll(mean),
             se    = roll(se),
             lower = pmax(mean - CONF * se, 0),
             upper = mean + CONF * se) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    n_tab <- long %>%
      distinct(spid, round, grp) %>%
      count(round, grp, name = "n_sub")
    
    list(curves = curves, n_tab = n_tab)
  }

  res_all <- compute_curves(analysis_dat)

  spids_r14 <- analysis_dat %>% filter(round == 14) %>% pull(spid) %>% unique()
  res_cc    <- compute_curves(filter(analysis_dat, spid %in% spids_r14))

  Y_MAX <- ceiling(max(c(res_all$curves$upper, res_cc$curves$upper),
                       na.rm = TRUE) / 500) * 500

  # Plot builder

  make_sex_plot <- function(res, y_max = Y_MAX,
                            legend_title = "Sex",
                            lab_x    = 0.4,     # inset from left, in hours
                            lab_gap  = 3.4,     # gap to the "(n = ...)" column
                            lab_top  = 0.972,   # first line, fraction of y_max
                            lab_step = 0.11,    # line spacing, fraction of y_max
                            lab_size = 2.9) {   # mm; ~8.2 pt
    
    curves <- res$curves
    n_tab  <- res$n_tab
    
    n_lab <- n_tab %>%
      arrange(round, grp) %>%
      group_by(round) %>%
      mutate(y     = y_max * (lab_top - (row_number() - 1) * lab_step),
             lab   = as.character(grp),
             n_txt = sprintf("(n = %d)", n_sub)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    lg_main  <- guide_legend(title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.5,
                             nrow = 1, order = 1,
                             override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1.1))
    lg_plain <- guide_legend(title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.5,
                             nrow = 1, order = 1)
    
    ggplot(curves, aes(hour, mean, colour = grp, fill = grp, linetype = grp)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.62, lineend = "round") +
      # sex label
      geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = lab_x, y = y, label = lab, colour = grp),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                size = lab_size, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
      # sample size, bracketed
      geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = lab_x + lab_gap, y = y, label = n_txt,
                                  colour = grp),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                size = lab_size, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
      facet_wrap(~ round, ncol = 2,
                 labeller = labeller(round = function(z) paste("Round", z))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 2), limits = c(0, 24),
                         expand = c(0.012, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, y_max, 500), limits = c(0, y_max),
                         expand = c(0.008, 0)) +
      scale_colour_manual(values   = SEX_COL, name = legend_title, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values     = SEX_COL, name = legend_title, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = SEX_LTY, name = legend_title, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = "Time of Day (hours)", y = "Mean daily activity") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = 0.22),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.35),
        panel.spacing.x   = unit(9, "pt"),
        panel.spacing.y   = unit(7, "pt"),
        strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey93", colour = "grey45",
                                         linewidth = 0.35),
        strip.text        = element_text(size = 8.8, face = "bold", colour = "grey15",
                                         margin = margin(t = 3.2, b = 3.2)),
        axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 9.2, margin = margin(t = 6)),
        axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 9.2, margin = margin(r = 6)),
        axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 7.2, colour = "grey25"),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 7.8, colour = "grey25"),
        axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.position   = "bottom",
        legend.title      = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 8)),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 8.4, margin = margin(r = 10, l = 3)),
        legend.key        = element_blank(),
        legend.key.width  = unit(20, "pt"),
        legend.key.height = unit(9, "pt"),
        legend.margin     = margin(t = 0, b = 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(t = -2),
        plot.margin       = margin(5, 7, 3, 5)
      ) +
      guides(colour = lg_main, fill = lg_plain, linetype = lg_plain)
  }

  # Build and export -- TIFF only

  sex_plot_all <- make_sex_plot(res_all)
  sex_plot_cc  <- make_sex_plot(res_cc)

  combined_sex <- (sex_plot_all / sex_plot_cc) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))

  combined_sex
})

figure_2

```

```{r figure-3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7.3, fig.height=9}
  AGE_COL_NAME <- "age_group"

  AGE_COL <- c("70-74" = "#1F4E79", "75-79" = "#2E8B94", "80-84" = "#6BA55C",
               "85-89" = "#D98324", "90+"   = "#B33A3A")
  AGE_LTY <- c("70-74" = "solid", "75-79" = "42", "80-84" = "62",
               "85-89" = "4212",  "90+"   = "12")

  # grid

  func_cols   <- grep("^dmeanmin", names(merged_clean), value = TRUE)
  minute_cols <- func_cols[order(as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", func_cols)))]
  n_grid <- length(minute_cols)
  mpp    <- 1440 / n_grid

  roll <- function(x, k = SMOOTH_WIN) {
    if (k <= 1) return(x)
    as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1 / k, k), sides = 2, circular = TRUE))
  }

  # baseline age group, constant within person

  stopifnot(AGE_COL_NAME %in% names(merged_clean))

  base_age_map <- merged_clean %>%
    filter(round == 11L) %>%
    distinct(spid, base_age = .data[[AGE_COL_NAME]])

  }

             hour  = (match(variable, minute_cols) - 0.5) * mpp / 60)

      summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                se   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(round, grp, hour) %>%
      group_by(round, grp) %>%
      mutate(mean  = roll(mean),
             se    = roll(se),
             lower = pmax(mean - CONF * se, 0),
             upper = mean + CONF * se) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    n_tab <- long %>%
      distinct(spid, round, grp) %>%
      count(round, grp, name = "n_sub")
    
    list(curves = curves, n_tab = n_tab)
  }

  res_all <- compute_curves(analysis_dat)

  spids_r14 <- analysis_dat %>% filter(round == 14) %>% pull(spid) %>% unique()
  res_cc    <- compute_curves(filter(analysis_dat, spid %in% spids_r14))

  Y_MAX <- ceiling(max(c(res_all$curves$upper, res_cc$curves$upper),
                       na.rm = TRUE) / 500) * 500

  # Plot builder

  make_age_plot <- function(res, y_max = Y_MAX,
                            legend_title = "Age group at baseline",
                            lab_x    = 0.4,     # inset from left, in hours
                            lab_gap  = 2.8,     # gap to the "(n = ...)" column
                            lab_top  = 0.972,   # first line, fraction of y_max
                            lab_step = 0.11,    # line spacing, fraction of y_max
                            lab_size = 2.9) {   # mm; ~8.2 pt
    
    curves <- res$curves

    n_lab <- n_tab %>%
      arrange(round, grp) %>%

      mutate(y     = y_max * (lab_top - (row_number() - 1) * lab_step),
             lab   = as.character(grp),
             n_txt = sprintf("(n = %d)", n_sub)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    lg_main  <- guide_legend(title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.5,
                             nrow = 1, order = 1,
                             override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1.1))
    lg_plain <- guide_legend(title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.5,
                             nrow = 1, order = 1)
    
    ggplot(curves, aes(hour, mean, colour = grp, fill = grp, linetype = grp)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.62, lineend = "round") +
      # age group label
      geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = lab_x, y = y, label = lab, colour = grp),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                size = lab_size, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
      # sample size, bracketed
      geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = lab_x + lab_gap, y = y, label = n_txt,
                                  colour = grp),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                size = lab_size, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
      facet_wrap(~ round, ncol = 2,
                 labeller = labeller(round = function(z) paste("Round", z))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 2), limits = c(0, 24),
                         expand = c(0.012, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, y_max, 500), limits = c(0, y_max),
                         expand = c(0.008, 0)) +
      scale_colour_manual(values   = AGE_COL, name = legend_title, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values     = AGE_COL, name = legend_title, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = AGE_LTY, name = legend_title, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = "Time of Day (hours)", y = "Mean daily activity") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = 0.22),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.35),
        panel.spacing.x   = unit(9, "pt"),
        panel.spacing.y   = unit(7, "pt"),
        strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey93", colour = "grey45",
                                         linewidth = 0.35),
        strip.text        = element_text(size = 8.8, face = "bold", colour = "grey15",
                                         margin = margin(t = 3.2, b = 3.2)),
        axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 9.2, margin = margin(t = 6)),
        axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 9.2, margin = margin(r = 6)),
        axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 7.2, colour = "grey25"),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 7.8, colour = "grey25"),
        axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.position   = "bottom",
        legend.title      = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 8)),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 8.4, margin = margin(r = 10, l = 3)),
        legend.key        = element_blank(),
        legend.key.width  = unit(20, "pt"),
        legend.key.height = unit(9, "pt"),
        legend.margin     = margin(t = 0, b = 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(t = -2),
        plot.margin       = margin(5, 7, 3, 5)
      ) +
      guides(colour = lg_main, fill = lg_plain, linetype = lg_plain)
  }

  # Build and export -- TIFF only

  age_plot_all <- make_age_plot(res_all)
  age_plot_cc  <- make_age_plot(res_cc)

  combined <- (age_plot_all / age_plot_cc) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))

  combined
})
```

## Figure 4: Significant and all eigenfunctions

```{r figure-4, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=13}
figure_4 <- local({
  phi   <- profit_result$phi
  P_METHOD <- 1L  # 1: NLME/RLRsim; 2: direct optimization
  npc <- profit_result$K
  pval <- as.numeric(profit_result$pValue[P_METHOD, ])
  stopifnot(length(pval) == npc, ncol(phi) >= npc)
  phi <- phi[, seq_len(npc), drop = FALSE]
  s <- seq_len(nrow(phi))
  alpha <- 0.05
  sig_idx <- which(pval <= alpha / npc)
  stopifnot(length(sig_idx) > 0)

  pc_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#1f78b4", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"))(max(3, length(sig_idx)))
  pc_colors[1:2] <- c("#1f78b4", "#e31a1c")

  # 2. Per-PC sign so orientation matches the reference figure
  #   PC1 should dip DOWN midday; PC2 should peak UP in the morning.
  #   Eigenfunction signs are arbitrary, so set each explicitly.
  #   If a curve comes out inverted, flip that entry: c(1,-1) <-> c(-1,1) etc.
  sign_all <- rep(1, npc)
  if (npc >= 2) sign_all[2] <- -1
  sign_vec <- sign_all[sig_idx]
  phi_signed <- sweep(phi[, sig_idx, drop = FALSE], 2, sign_vec, `*`)

  # 3. Long-format data
  plot_df <- as.data.frame(phi_signed) %>%
    setNames(paste0("PC", sig_idx)) %>%
    mutate(hours = s / 60) %>%
    pivot_longer(-hours, names_to = "PC", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(PC = factor(PC, levels = paste0("PC", sig_idx)))

  # 4. Legend labels with % variance (if eigenvalues available)
  pve <- if (!is.null(profit_result$eigen_val))
    round(100 * profit_result$eigen_val / sum(profit_result$eigen_val), 1) else NULL
  leg_labels <- if (!is.null(pve))
    paste0("PC", sig_idx, " (", pve[sig_idx], "%)") else paste0("PC", sig_idx)

  # 5. Plot
  sig_eigen <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(hours, value, colour = PC)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pc_colors[seq_along(sig_idx)],
                        labels = leg_labels, name = "Principal Component") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
    labs(
      title = "Significant PCs of Physical Activity (Bonferroni-adjusted)",
      x = "Time of Day (hours)",
      y = expression(phi[k](s))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      legend.position      = c(0.99, 0.99),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = "grey80"),
      legend.title         = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major     = element_line(colour = "grey90")
    )

  phi <- profit_result$phi[, seq_len(npc), drop = FALSE]
  s   <- seq_len(nrow(phi))
  time_hours <- s / 60
  pct <- 100 * profit_result$eigen_val[seq_len(npc)] / sum(profit_result$eigen_val)
  K   <- ncol(phi)

  # Keep component signs consistent with panel A.
  phi_o <- sweep(phi, 2, sign_all, `*`)

  pc_labels <- paste0("PC", 1:K, "\n(", round(pct, 1), "% variance)")

  phi_df <- as.data.frame(phi_o) %>%
    setNames(paste0("PC", 1:K)) %>%
    mutate(Time = time_hours) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Time, names_to = "PC", values_to = "Eigenfunction") %>%
    mutate(PC_num = readr::parse_number(PC),
           PC_lab = factor(pc_labels[PC_num], levels = pc_labels))

  cols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(K)

  all_eig_plot <- ggplot(phi_df, aes(Time, Eigenfunction, colour = factor(PC_num))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ PC_lab, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 6)) +
    labs(x = "Time of Day (Hours)", y = expression(phi[k](s)),
         title = "Functional Principal Component Eigenfunctions") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", colour = "black"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"))

  combined <- (sig_eigen / all_eig_plot) +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))

  combined
})
```

```{r figure-5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
figure_5 <- local({
  merged_clean <- figure_dat

  mean_act<- rowMeans(as.matrix(merged_clean[, func_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)

  # oriented projection scores (same construction as your models)
  Phi    <- profit_result$phi[, seq_len(profit_result$K), drop = FALSE]
  proj   <- as.matrix(merged_clean[, func_cols]) %*% Phi / length(func_cols)
  K      <- profit_result$K

  corr_df <- tibble(

  corr_df <- corr_df %>%

      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme(

      panel.grid        = element_blank(),
      legend.position   = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1.6, "lines"),
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

  corr_plot
})
```

## Figure 6: Paired differences between rounds

Panel A compares consecutive rounds; panel B compares Rounds 12-14 with Round 11. The main figure displays the pointwise intervals, while the optional diagnostic export also displays simultaneous bands. Your original bootstrap settings (1,000 resamples, seed 123) are retained.

```{r figure-6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
figure_6_results <- local({
  merged_clean <- figure_dat
  minute_cols <- profit_columns[order(parse_number(profit_columns))]

  smooth_vec <- function(y, x, span = 0.08) {
    ok <- is.finite(y)
    if (sum(ok) < 20) return(y)
    fit <- loess(y ~ x, data = data.frame(x = x[ok], y = y[ok]),
                 span = span, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
    as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x)))
  }

  # 3) Paired difference matrix for two rounds
  #    CONVENTION: later - earlier  (positive = higher in later round)
  #    so pass (round_later, round_earlier)
  make_diff_mat <- function(data, round_later, round_earlier, minute_cols) {
    a <- data %>% filter(round == round_later)  %>% select(spid, all_of(minute_cols))
    b <- data %>% filter(round == round_earlier) %>% select(spid, all_of(minute_cols))
    common_ids <- intersect(a$spid, b$spid)
    a <- a %>% filter(spid %in% common_ids) %>% arrange(spid)
    b <- b %>% filter(spid %in% common_ids) %>% arrange(spid)
    stopifnot(length(common_ids) >= 2, identical(a$spid, b$spid))
    list(common_ids = common_ids,
         diff_mat   = as.matrix(a[, minute_cols]) - as.matrix(b[, minute_cols]))
  }

  # 4) Bootstrap pointwise + simultaneous band
  #    Also returns a joint p-value for "any minute differs from 0",
  #    The FPCA option approximates simultaneous calibration across minutes.
  boot_joint_band <- function(diff_mat, B = 1000, conf = 0.95,
                              smooth = TRUE, span = 0.08,
                              use_fpca = TRUE, fpca_pve = 0.95,
                              Nsim = 5000, seed = 123) {
    set.seed(seed)
    n <- nrow(diff_mat); L <- ncol(diff_mat)
    minute <- seq_len(L); alpha <- 1 - conf
    
    obs_mean <- colMeans(diff_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    boot_mean <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = L)
    for (b in seq_len(B)) {
      idx <- sample.int(n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
      boot_mean[b, ] <- colMeans(diff_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    if (smooth) {
      obs_mean <- smooth_vec(obs_mean, minute, span = span)
      for (b in seq_len(B)) boot_mean[b, ] <- smooth_vec(boot_mean[b, ], minute, span = span)
    }
    
    # pointwise percentile band (UNCORRECTED — per-minute)
    pt_lower <- apply(boot_mean, 2, quantile, probs = alpha / 2,     na.rm = TRUE)
    pt_upper <- apply(boot_mean, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    boot_se <- pmax(apply(boot_mean, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE), .Machine$double.eps)
    
    # simultaneous band via supremum statistic (CORRECTED across minutes)
    if (use_fpca) {
      pca <- prcomp(boot_mean, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
      pve <- cumsum(pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
      K   <- which(pve >= fpca_pve)[1]
      mu  <- colMeans(boot_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
      phi <- pca$rotation[, 1:K, drop = FALSE]
      sds <- pca$sdev[1:K]
      sup_stat <- replicate(Nsim, {
        z <- rnorm(K, 0, sds)
        curve <- as.numeric(mu + phi %*% z)
        max(abs((curve - obs_mean) / boot_se), na.rm = TRUE)
      })
    } else {
      z_boot <- abs(sweep(boot_mean, 2, obs_mean, "-")) /
        matrix(boot_se, nrow = B, ncol = L, byrow = TRUE)
      sup_stat <- apply(z_boot, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    crit <- as.numeric(quantile(sup_stat, probs = conf, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    sim_lower <- obs_mean - crit * boot_se
    sim_upper <- obs_mean + crit * boot_se
    
    # joint p-value: observed sup-|z| vs its bootstrap null
    obs_sup  <- max(abs(obs_mean / boot_se), na.rm = TRUE)
    joint_p  <- mean(sup_stat >= obs_sup)
    
    list(
      band = tibble(minute, mean_diff = obs_mean,
                    pt_lower, pt_upper, sim_lower, sim_upper),
      joint_p = joint_p
    )
  }

  # Bootstrap matched participants for each comparison.
  run_comparisons <- function(comparisons) {
    fits <- pmap(comparisons, function(later, earlier, label) {
      dm <- make_diff_mat(merged_clean, later, earlier, minute_cols)
      res <- boot_joint_band(dm$diff_mat, B = 1000, smooth = TRUE, span = 0.08,
                             use_fpca = TRUE, fpca_pve = 0.95, Nsim = 5000, seed = 123)
      res$band <- res$band %>% mutate(comparison = label)
      res$n_pairs <- length(dm$common_ids)
      res
    })
    list(
      band = map_dfr(fits, "band") %>%
        mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = comparisons$label)),
      joint = comparisons %>%
        mutate(n_pairs = map_int(fits, "n_pairs"),
               joint_p = pmax(map_dbl(fits, "joint_p"), 1 / 5000),
               p_holm = p.adjust(joint_p, method = "holm"),
               reject = p_holm < 0.05)
    )
  }

  consecutive <- tibble(
    later = c(12, 13, 14), earlier = c(11, 12, 13),
    label = c("Round 12 - Round 11", "Round 13 - Round 12", "Round 14 - Round 13")
  )
  baseline <- tibble(
    later = c(12, 13, 14), earlier = c(11, 11, 11),
    label = c("Round 12 - Round 11", "Round 13 - Round 11", "Round 14 - Round 11")
  )
  res_consecutive <- run_comparisons(consecutive)
  res_baseline <- run_comparisons(baseline)

  # Main manuscript: pointwise intervals only.
  make_difference_plot <- function(res, title, include_simultaneous = FALSE) {
    bands_long <- res$band %>%
      pivot_longer(c(pt_lower, pt_upper, sim_lower, sim_upper),
                   names_to = c("band", ".value"),
                   names_pattern = "(pt|sim)_(lower|upper)") %>%
      mutate(band = factor(recode(band, pt = "Pointwise CI", sim = "Simultaneous CI"),
                           levels = c("Pointwise CI", "Simultaneous CI")))
    if (!include_simultaneous) {
      bands_long <- filter(bands_long, band == "Pointwise CI")
    }
    cols <- setNames(c("#3B528B", "#21908C", "#5DC863"), levels(res$band$comparison))

    p <- ggplot(bands_long, aes(minute)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = comparison),
                  alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(aes(y = mean_diff, colour = comparison), linewidth = 1.1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1440, 120), labels = seq(0, 24, 2),
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
      labs(title = title, x = "Time of Day (Hours)",
           y = "Mean Difference in Physical Activity", colour = "Comparison", fill = "Comparison") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 15, base_family = "serif") +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
    if (include_simultaneous) p + facet_grid(band ~ comparison, scales = "free_y")
    else p + facet_grid(. ~ comparison, scales = "free_y")
  }

  p1 <- make_difference_plot(res_consecutive, "Differences between consecutive rounds")
  p2 <- make_difference_plot(res_baseline, "Differences from Round 11 baseline")
  combined <- (p1 / p2) +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))

  list(plot = combined,
       consecutive = res_consecutive, baseline = res_baseline,
       diagnostic = (make_difference_plot(res_consecutive, "Consecutive rounds", TRUE) /
                     make_difference_plot(res_baseline, "Versus Round 11", TRUE)) +
         plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A"))
})

figure_6 <- figure_6_results$plot
figure_6

```

The bootstrap comparison summaries remain available as `figure_6_results$consecutive$joint` and `figure_6_results$baseline$joint`. The source code adjusts joint p-values separately within the two sets of three comparisons; the main figure ribbons are pointwise intervals.
